ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 82% low-intensity (black) to 18% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central area is primarily low-intensity. High-intensity contiguous blobs are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes. A large, irregular high-intensity patch is located on the right distal lobe edge. Small high-intensity circular focal points are scattered medially on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with a vertex angle of approximately 48 degrees and a vertical depth of approximately 85 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations along the trailing edge. Amplitude of variations is highest (15-20 pixels) at the lateral tips and lowest (2-5 pixels) near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Mathematical concave curve fitted from the median notch vertex to the extreme lateral tips of each lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 15-20 localized circular high-contrast pixel clusters on the right lobe and 5-8 on the left lobe, primarily near the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent high-contrast diagonal linear scar (length ~120 pixels) on the right lobe; additional faint parallel linear disruptions visible in the medial region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent diagonal linear scar on the right lobe; irregular, highly serrated topography at the lateral lobe tips consistent with extensive scarring or barnacle attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast ring-shaped scar located in the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe.
